groups.title: Monthly demand and smoothing fixture
groups.scope: March/April/May quantities 7/4/9 match buckets; average and June forecast match the fixture formula; June forecast column is present while June raw and March historical columns are absent.

groups.title: May history fixture with draft and boundary orders
groups.scope: May quantity equals 6 with a submitted May order of 6, a draft May order of 100 and an order of 100 at FROM_DATE present. This does not separately check every other month bucket.

groups.title: Flat future forecast fixture
groups.scope: History 100/100/100 with alpha 0.3 produces 100 for June, July and August to six decimal places.

groups.title: Document denial and customer restriction fixture
groups.scope: Stock User invoice execution raises PermissionError; the fixture item is absent for Sales User restricted to Customer 1. One grouped test, not separately observed subclaims or proof of every customer row.

groups.title: Select without Read denies invoice access
groups.scope: The fixture user has a role granting Sales Invoice Select with Read removed; report execution must raise PermissionError.

limits: Statuses describe whole named fixture tests, not general policy proofs.
A failing grouped test may stop before later assertions; subclaim outcomes are not separately observed.
Descriptions interpret pinned historical tests; they are not an approved customer policy or independently discovered requirements.
